verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit names a 'Pre-Merge Checks' feature that ties into its request-changes workflow, which can block PRs (docs-47, docs-67, supp-4). Reviews run automatically on every PR (docs-39, docs-70). Path instructions let users write natural-language guidance such as test coverage requirements or documentation clarity rules (docs-8, docs-48). However, the evidence never shows users authoring custom pre-merge checks in plain language, nor how such checks pass or fail. missing for 10: documentation of user-defined plain-language pre-merge check definitions, pass/fail semantics for checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', independent or hands-on corroboration.
